title: Fellowship for Medical Sciences
summary: Bayer Foundation Fellowship for Medical Sciences supports international students planning to study, research, or intern in Germany in medical and health sciences fields. Includes Master's and PhD students; excludes postdocs.

degree_levels.notes: Master's or PhD students; Bachelor's students and postdocs cannot receive funding (Bachelor's and postdocs excluded).

subject_areas.notes: Human or veterinary medicine, medical engineering, applied medical sciences, public health, or data science in medicine.

nationality.notes: Country eligibility depends on the application portal list; no explicit universal unrestricted statement on page.

residence.notes: International students who plan to study, research or do an internship in Germany.

preferences.text: {'string': 'Projects should be as interdisciplinary and collaborative as possible and focus primarily on health in low- and middle-income countries or treatment of rare or orphan diseases.'}

funding.description: individual financial support, but limited to 10,000 EUR per request

application_rounds.notes: Application deadlines can be found on the Bayer Foundation website.

sources.notes: International students can receive funding for study, research or internships in Germany. Postdocs are excluded.
